Class UDFFillWriter

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.UDFFillWriter
@Service public class UDFFillWriter extends Object
The only code path that writes an automatic value or a fill row. Each call runs in its own short transaction (PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW) and locks the udf_data row of the owner of the field and the fill row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE before it decides, so that a user save that committed earlier is seen and a user save that commits later overwrites the document with the user's values: manual values never lose. A write changes only the key f<id> of the field and leaves every sibling key as it was read.

    • recordProposal

      public boolean recordProposal(UDFMetadataSecurity field, int idSecurity, UDFFillWriter.ProposalRecord proposal)
      Records the verified outcome of a language model for an empty cell: PROPOSED with the value and its evidence, DISCARDED or NOT_FOUND with the reason. A proposal is never written into udf_data. Nothing is recorded when the cell is locked, got a value meanwhile, or the field changed since the outcome was computed.
      Parameters:
      field - the field as it was when the outcome was computed
      idSecurity - the security
      proposal - the state to record and its details
      Returns:
      true when the row was recorded

    • refreshApplied

      public boolean refreshApplied(UDFMetadataSecurity field, int idSecurity, UDFFillWriter.ProposalRecord proposal)
      Records the periodic refresh of a value the user once accepted. A verified proposal replaces the value without a new acceptance and is written with its source and excerpt under the current rule version. Any other outcome keeps the value and only sets the check time and the reason, so the cell is asked again only after the next period. Nothing is written when the cell no longer holds the automatic value, for instance because the user changed it or took it over, or when the field changed since the outcome was computed.
      Parameters:
      field - the field as it was when the outcome was computed
      idSecurity - the security
      proposal - the outcome; only PROPOSED carries a value
      Returns:
      true when the row was updated

    • acceptProposal

      public UDFFillProposalDecisionResult.Outcome acceptProposal(UDFMetadataSecurity field, int idSecurity, UDFFillProposalDecision decision)
      Accepts a proposal the user saw. The value is written only when the row is still PROPOSED with the version and value the user saw and the field is unchanged; a manual value that arrived meanwhile wins and the proposal is dropped. Accepting an already accepted proposal again answers APPLIED.
      Parameters:
      field - the field of the caller
      idSecurity - the security
      decision - version and value the user saw
      Returns:
      APPLIED, CONFLICT or STALE

    • rejectProposal

      public UDFFillProposalDecisionResult.Outcome rejectProposal(UDFMetadataSecurity field, int idSecurity, UDFFillProposalDecision decision)
      Rejects a proposal the user saw, under the same conditions as an accept. Rejecting again answers REJECTED.
      Parameters:
      field - the field of the caller
      idSecurity - the security
      decision - version and value the user saw
      Returns:
      REJECTED or STALE
